summary: Two auth defects existed on routes nobody had exercised with a non-admin credential, and both would have broken the pendant silently.
one: /v1/pendant/converse compared the header literally against the admin key, so a paired nrf_pendant token was refused on the pendant main voice path.
two: The pendant alert inbox (GET /v1/state/pendant-alerts, polled by pendant_store.c) had no scope granted to nrf_pendant, so a scoped pendant would have taken a silent 403 on every poll.
lesson: A route that only ever sees one credential is untested auth. The scope table is the place this becomes visible, which is why it was extracted out of server.js into a testable module.
scopeJudgement: The pendant was given pendant:alerts:read on that one path rather than the blanket state:read the Mac bridge holds, because the same key space contains agent-snapshot and fleet. A chest-worn losable device should not be able to read the Mac world model.
